credentials: Featured in WHO Documentary on Hepatitis Response
Brother's loss to liver cancer (2021) - catalyst for THA
team.bioShort: Shaibu founded THA after losing his brother Latifu to liver cancer in 2021—a preventable disease if diagnosed early. Having personally faced Hepatitis B and the stigma associated with it, Shaibu transformed his personal tragedy into purpose.
team.bioFull:
After losing his brother Latifu to liver cancer in 2021, Shaibu Issa was driven to action. Latifu's death was preventable—a consequence of late diagnosis and lack of access to care. Shaibu, having personally faced Hepatitis B and the stigma it carries, realized that thousands of Tanzanians suffer from the same challenges.

In January 2025, Shaibu founded Tanzania Health Alliance to ensure no one else dies from a preventable disease due to misinformation, late detection, or stigma. His mission is to transform Tanzania's response to Hepatitis, HIV, and Mental Health.

In 2025, Shaibu was recognized globally when THA was featured in a WHO documentary highlighting innovative hepatitis responses. By March 2026, he had been elected to the World Hepatitis Alliance Board—a testament to his advocacy impact.

Shaibu believes that health equity is achievable, and that every Tanzanian—regardless of wealth or location—deserves access to prevention, testing, and care.
team.why: Channeling personal loss into systemic change. Every life saved is Latifu's legacy.
